name: smwpatches-castle-destruction-cutscene-exgfx
title: Castle Destruction Cutscene ExGFX
description:
This patch allows you to load custom (Ex)GFX files for each of the 7 castle destruction cutscenes. To do so, just edit the tables sp1-sp4,fg1-fg3,bg1 in the asm file.
Note: you can't insert GFX files in slots BG2-BG3, and you can only use (Ex)GFX numbers $00-$FF.

Requested by SimFan96.
